text.description_html:
Omnia SD1-720/200, Satin Stainless Steel Retro Door Pull

Retro styled satin stainless steel glass door pull is 15" overall length with 8-5/8" center to center mounting hole spacing. It is made from premium grade 304 solid stainless steel. Packaged with decorative nut for mounting on one side of glass doors.

Also available as a Pair of Retro Design Stainless Steel Glass Door Pulls for both sides of glass door.

Specifications for the Omnia SD1-720/220-US32D Stainless Steel Glass Door Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 15"
  • Length Center to center: 8-5/8"
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Pull Diameter: 1-3/16" at Widest Point in Center of Pull
  • Mounting Brackets Diameter: 3/4"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

Packaged with 1 door pull, decorative nuts plus mounting hardware for mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.
